candidates.change_summary: Replace selfdestruct target to send remaining balance to contract owner __owner instead of msg.sender.
Replace selfdestruct target to send remaining balance to address(0) (burn) instead of msg.sender.
Remove selfdestruct call and instead transfer the contract balance to msg.sender using payable(msg.sender).transfer, changing post-call observable state (contract not destroyed).
Modify the __onlyOwner modifier to require msg.sender != __owner (invert owner check), allowing only non-owner to call sudicideAnyone.
